episodes.instruction: Pick the paymentsign with QR code off the table using the left arm and rotate it.
Pick up the paymentsign with smooth base stand and rotate it to face its QR code toward you.
Catch the QR code payment sign from the table and make it face you.
Grab the paymentsign with smooth base stand, lift it, and rotate until the QR code faces you.
Pick the paymentsign with smooth base stand off the table using the left arm and rotate it.
Grab the paymentsign with angled support bars, lift it, and rotate to see the qrcode.
Grab the black triangular stand, lift it, and rotate to see the qrcode.
Pick the paymentsign with smooth base stand up from the table and rotate it.
Catch the paymentsign with angled stand on the table and pick it up.
Catch the tabletop paymentsign from the table and make it face you.
Pick the paymentsign with black metal stand up from the table and rotate it.
Catch the paymentsign with angled support bars from the table and make it face you.
Catch the paymentsign with black metal stand on the table and pick it up.
Grab the black triangular stand, lift it, and rotate to see the qrcode.
Grab the QR code payment sign, lift it, and rotate until the QR code faces you.
Pick up the QR code payment sign and rotate it facing you.
Grab the paymentsign with angled stand, lift it, and rotate to see the qrcode.
